policy: Reviewed configuration associations use supplied diagrams for route identity only, independent operator evidence, and pinned reusable trace geometry. Whole-member fingerprints detect changed inputs without reading course-data values. These associations are separate from identical-file aliases and never establish timing equivalence.

records.name: Bedford GT New 1511
records.evidence: The supplied diagram identifies the GT branch sequence: complete western course, northern triangle, central S connector and direct eastern outer return. The operator GT plan independently identifies those same branches, and the pinned public-node and licensed one-metre survey recipe supplies their geometry. This associates the legacy filename with the existing draft GT route only. It does not establish identical timing, historical corner radii or identical course-file contents. No archive diagram is georeferenced or digitized and no course-data values are parsed.
